review_text: Although pricier than most cafés… • Quality: The food options live up to the price. 👌🏻 Drinks like matcha and hojicha are consistently excellent. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 • Atmosphere: Great music selection and nice lighting. At times, though, other customers can be noisy; noise management could use improvement. • Store hours: Open 24 hours!!! 😇 • Other perks: If you're a regular and live nearby, they offer a loyalty card.

Disclaimer: If you are looking for a place to study, save yourself some time – do not go here. First, the coffee is so good, my friends and I would rate it a 9/10. I personally liked their beans. It's also nice that they serve it on glass, less plastic for our planet. 🍃 Second, since we are 3 in total, I asked the cashier kindly if we could use two (2) tables, kasi hindi na magkakasya yung laptop/tablet nung isa naming kasama. The cashier answered that we can't because 1 table is intended for 3-4 persons daw. So dahil mahirap talaga pagkasyahin, my friend sat down on the sofa instead. (See last photo) Now, here comes 2 customers, pinagdikit nila yung two tables sa may CR, then set up their laptops and all. (See third photo) To our mind, sana pala hindi na tayo nagpaalam, or perhaps they're the owners kaya hindi sinita. Sana lang naging clear yung rules. 😅 Lastly, while we acknowledge that this café is not a study hub, we would greatly appreciate if the staff would also be kind to treat everyone fair and square. We went here because of its reputation, but ended up kind of disappointed. Still, if we were to go back, we would still; sans the study session, because it will really get loud 9:00 PM onwards. Thank you parin! 🫶

The coffee was too sweet for my liking and the carbonara was okay (kinda expected more?) Unfortunately, I had a hard time connecting to their internet ans it's not so fast din pero okay na if you dont need to download videos. I love the paintings and how artsy the place is. Sadly, medj maingay ang place or the people who visited it for my liking.

Been here a LOT of times na, and I always order their Hojicha and it never disappoints. Their coffee and soda drinks are good to. Tried their Carbonara, it was creamy with a generous serving. Their desserts ay hindi nakakaumay 😋, which I really liked. The space is big and well-lit, making it perfect for barkada hang-outs, group studies, or group work. PLUS POINTS KASI THEY HAVE PLENTY OF SOCKETS HEHEHEHE. The staff are nice and accommodating, and yk what's the best part??? THEY ARE OPEN 24 HOURS! 🫶🏻 So, if you're looking for a place to hang-out, chill, or work you can always check out KAOS.

This was truly my me and my family's favorite place to have breakfast in all of Davao…no joke! The bangsilog is hands down the best I've ever had. Everything was cooked perfectly, complete with vegetables to and full of flavor. The specialty coffee and refreshments were clearly made with care, and you can really taste the difference. The service was exceptional…warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Everyone who helped us was so kind (they all deserve a raise!). It also feels like a bit of a hidden gem since it wasn't too busy during our visits, which made the experience even more enjoyable and relaxed. Thank you so much for the excellent hospitality and amazing food. We'll definitely be back!

This was our first time ordering from Kaos, and unfortunately, it was a disappointing experience. I specifically ordered the BONELESS BANGUS because I recently got braces and wanted something easier and safer to eat. However, when the food arrived, I found that the fish still contained bones. My partner informed one of the staff members, who then checked with the kitchen. We were told that this is what they ordered (maybe they are referring to their supplier) and while they apologized, no replacement or refund was offered. Since I had already received the meal, I had no choice but to carefully eat around the bones, which was quite inconvenient and defeated the purpose of ordering a boneless dish in the first place. I hope the restaurant can improve its quality control and customer service when such issues arise. Customers should receive the product as advertised. Matcha: ⭐⭐ Hojika: ⭐⭐ Katsudon: ⭐⭐ (too much oil) Boneless Bangus: (no star for me) To be fair, this was my first time visiting and ordering from Kaos Cafe. This review is based solely on my personal experience during that visit and is not intended to harm the restaurant's reputation. P. S: As you can see on the photo it was not de-boned.

Very accomodating even i almost stayed 10 hrs, i was worried na sobrang over na stay ko (tas nka idlip pa cuz i was working for 8hrs, from 10pm-7am) but they didn't let me feel na need ko nang umalis. Ordered their Modernized matcha and blueberry cheesecake, worth it for the price. Overall, this is indeed worth visiting for especially to those ppl who work remotely with nightshifts. And also very accessible since near lang sa roxas. Will go back soon with my friends/sisters😍

September 28, 2025 Just walked from Brew Lane to see this area. Cool concept. Got in and was about to leave as I fear no seat but there was this couch next to great wall art. I'm feeling Strawberry Rothko at that time but they said they ran out of the syrup. Settled with the ₱180 8oz Choco Picasso. Liked the barista skill on it to glorify the heated milk chocolate drink. I've had enough sikwate to say this isn't for me. Will come back when I decide the KAOS drink or food to take. Update: October 26, 2025 around 9:30pm to 5am next day Shared some ₱229 Brushstroke pork katsudon. And that's that then stayed there until 5am next day. I have to say that experiencing more from this cafe allowed me to state more. I have to say that from time to time street children have frequented the area. I have nothing against them and if the area is for them, go ahead. Please take care of them as you have took care of us customers. There is also one customer who was blatantly loud in arrival and departure then so on. It was a turnoff for guests like me that I had to switch tables subtlely. I appreciate your tolerance for most guests especially when they pay a lot but do read the room and assist those affected. If it's too much, it's alright. We will adjust. I appreciate the constant hot water refills as the night to midnight to day is cold. I need this service. May or may not come because it's a farther route in Roxas. Thanks for your service.
Ordered their matcha latte and creme brûlée cake, ilang matcha tab-ang for my liking still good, decent naman. The cake is dry. Great place to hag out.

Kaos Cafe is my new favorite spot because it perfectly balances a productive work vibe with the best atmosphere for a barkada hangout. Whether I'm tucked into a corner with my laptop and a great latte or sharing a big table and some laughs with my friends, the space feels incredibly welcoming and full of life. The food and drinks choices are top-tier and the staff always makes us feel right at home, making it the absolute best all-around hangout in the neighborhood.
Stayed for lunch and short working the place has a nice vibe to it plus plenty of seating, maybe cramped during lunch. With lots of socket for charging (foc) and complimentary wifi. Food is great.

The drinks were excellent. We ordered the Seasalt Matcha and the Coco Matcha, and both were as quality and delicious as we expected. Unfortunately, the service did not match the quality of the beverages. When we arrived, we sat at a table that had not been cleared. Despite the staff being active and serving other customers who arrived after us, our table remained dirty. When our drinks were served, the server placed them directly among the leftover food and cups from the previous party. Since the server knew the order was ours, it was clear we had just arrived and were not the ones who had left the mess. We waited, expecting someone to return and clear the area, but the staff continued to walk back and forth past us to serve other tables without attending to ours. After waiting for several minutes and finishing only half of our drinks, we decided to leave because the uncleaned table made the environment too uncomfortable to stay in. I really enjoy your menu, but sitting at a dirty table significantly takes away from the experience. I hope this feedback helps your team improve their table maintenance flow so future guests can fully enjoy their visit.

One of the best Coffee, Matcha and Food in Davao City! You'll know a store that loves its clients when it's always tidy and clean. Food service is amazing and always deliciously served fresh and hot. Has WiFi and Clean restrooms, also have outlets for people who would like to work a bit there. Food prices are also affordable. The Interior is well curated and lights are well balanced for the clients eyes. That's why KAOS is one of the best Cafe's in Davao City.

We waited more than an hour for the food to be served. Their reason? They only have one person in the kitchen and is new to the job. We would understand that if they have been transparent about it but they just left us guessing when our food will be served while other customers that came later than us get served. We came here with a lot of expectations as we heard a lot of good reviews about the food, not just from online but from friend and colleagues as well. The food is good, but the service is so bad! They didn't even acknowledge their mistake. They heard us getting impatient, one of us went to the counter several times to follow up with the food but they just kept on saying 5 minutes. There's a lot of 5 minutes in an hour, imagine. Do better. Edit as reply to owner: Thank you for assuring us that you'll relay this concern to your staff, but I would like to reiterate that we indeed waited for over an hour, as our dishes were only served well after 9:50 AM. We arrived at approximately 8:40 AM, appreciated being accommodated and seated, and started ordering around 8:50 AM. So no, this was not just a case of "waiting feels longer when you're hungry." We kept track of the time, and your response feels dismissive and invalidating of our concern. What makes this even more frustrating is that the place was practically empty when we arrived, so the long wait is difficult to justify. It was also such a slap to see customers who arrived after us get served first. If there was only one kitchen staff member and they were new, shouldn't the dishes have at least been prepared and served chronologically based on when orders were placed? And frankly, are customers supposed to feel indebted to you simply because you chose to remain open despite the LGU encouraging businesses to suspend operations today? If you decide to operate, then customers should still be able to expect decent service and proper food handling, not be made to feel guilty for expecting the bare minimum. We repeatedly raised concerns about how long the food was taking, yet we were repeatedly shrugged off. When the food finally arrived, it was not even hot, which clearly suggests it had been sitting at the counter for some time before being served. No one likes being kept waiting that long for food, especially with little acknowledgment or accountability. Your service was poor, and that is the reality of our experience. Accepting feedback instead of making excuses would have gone a lot further. This also does not seem to be an isolated incident, as others have voiced similar concerns about your service. Again, do better.

The food is good but the serving is not giving. The atmosphere is cozy but the service is so trash. We waited 1 hour before our order arrived. Their reason is there is only 1 person in the kitchen and was "overwhelmed." I have browsed through your feedbacks and have noticed the same feedback dated few months ago. Seriously? Do better.

The coffee shop is good, affordable price. The thing is if you use card as MOP there's a minimum purchase of 250 and you'll end up paying 300+ for food or drink (or both) since their price range is below 250. Got 2 hrs free wifi every purchase. Their pasta is on the sweet side, so I don't kinda like it but their coffee is good. I was gonna try their Durian Coffee but they're out of stock.

Cool, clean and spacious café with unique abstract art on the walls and some of it for sale. I was greeted by the friendly and helpful staff. They have an extensive drink menu and if you don't see something you like, they will make you a custom drink to your liking. I decided on The Van Gogh Coffee Cloud. The drink was wonderful! Bold, smooth and lightly sweetened with coconut water and cream. Perfect drink for a warm day. I didn't order any food, but the food I did see looked and smelled good. They have WiFi for 2 hours with your purchase of food/coffee and the CR was clean. It's open 24 hours. Overall great experience!

was blown away by its rich flavor I profile! Not my first time here, though I wouldn't say I'm a regular either. I've been visiting this coffee shop since last year. Honestly, not every visit is because I'm craving coffee, sometimes it's simply because of the warm hospitality of the staff (especially the ones who are now assigned to the Marfori branch). Today, I visited the main branch while running some errands, and I wasn't aware that there had been changes to the policies since the staff lineup also changed. The new bartender came across as a bit sarcastic and not very approachable. The only exception was the cashier, who was friendly and accommodating. I also noticed some changes this time. There's now an additional ₱10 charge for takeout food, which wasn't the case last month. They also give only one Wi-Fi voucher per order/item, which is different from the Marfori branch I visited just a week ago. Kaos has always been one of my comfort places whenever I get bored working from home. I've even completed their stamp cards several times since last year. I just hope the policies stay consistent, even as you expand and open new branches. Thank you.

I asked the staff about the variety of matcha being used, and the only response I received was "ceremonial," without further explanation. I would also like to note that the store was not busy at that time, which made the delay more concerning. While our order was being prepared, one of the staff members sneezed while making our order without covering their mouth or stepping away from the preparation area. Unfortunately, the food and equipment were exposed at that time. In addition, the staff was not wearing proper food safety attire, such as a face mask, which is a basic standard in food handling. This situation was concerning, as proper hygiene and food safety protocols are essential in maintaining customer trust and ensuring health and safety. I believe staff should be properly trained and consistently reminded about hygiene standards, including wearing appropriate uniforms and face masks, and knowing what to do when coughing or sneezing while on duty. I hope management can take this feedback seriously and strengthen training and enforcement of food safety and hygiene protocols to prevent similar incidents in the future. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Kaos Cafe has quickly established itself as a vibrant go-to destination for anyone looking to pair a cozy atmosphere with genuinely satisfying meals. Nestled conveniently in the city, the cafe offers an inviting escape where patrons can unwind, catch up with friends, or enjoy a quiet moment. Beyond its relaxed interior and charming street-side vibes, the true highlight of the experience lies in its kitchen, which consistently turns out food that punches well above the typical cafe fare. The menu boasts a stellar lineup of comforting favorites, ranging from savory Japanese rice bowls like their crispy Chicken Katsudon to hearty breakfast classics and flavorful pasta dishes. Each plate is prepared with careful attention to taste and presentation, ensuring that every bite delivers on flavor without feeling heavy or rushed. Whether you are grabbing a quick mid-day bite or settling in for a leisurely meal, the comforting portions and well-balanced seasonings make it easy to find something you will love. Of course, no cafe trip would be complete without something to drink, and Kaos Cafe pairs its savory options with an impressive beverage selection. Their specialty iced coffees and rich lattes provide the ideal caffeinated kick, rounding out the dining experience seamlessly. Thanks to its winning combination of great food, inviting ambiance, and dependable drinks, Kaos Cafe delivers an all-around dining experience that keeps locals and visitors coming back for more.
